FIELDS.NAME: Cedar Ridge Construction Group
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Project Manager, Cedar Ridge Construction Group, (555) 123-4567, john.smith@cedarridgeconstruct.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Cedar Ridge Construction Group specializes in residential construction, focusing primarily on new home builds and interior renovations for single-family homes. We manage projects from start to finish, ensuring quality craftsmanship and adherence to local building codes. Our operations are centered in Springfield, IL, where we maintain a commitment to employing licensed subcontractors for specialized trades such as electrical, plumbing, and HVAC work. We prioritize safety and compliance, implementing a written safety program and maintaining up-to-date OSHA documentation. Our team is dedicated to minimizing risk exposure by keeping subcontractor work under 30% of our total annual costs and ensuring all subcontractors provide certificates of insurance. With a solid reputation for reliability and integrity, we have maintained a clean regulatory record and a history free of claims over the past five years.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Cedar Ridge Renovations LLC, a subsidiary specializing in kitchen and bathroom remodels for residential properties.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: "Loss dates: 06/15/2022; Cause: Minor property damage during a renovation project due to water leak; Amount: $3,500; Status: Claim settled."
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Fencing and onsite watchpersons for project security during construction.
